title: glandularia tweedieana
intro: Glandularia tweedieana, commonly known as Rockrose or Marsh Pink, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Verbenaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating respiratory issues due to its expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Glandularia tweedieana are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
